comparisons.scheme1_value: Gives Rs. 6,000 per year cash to landholding farmers to buy seeds, fertilizer, and other farm inputs.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Opens a free bank account for people without banking access, giving them a place to save money safely.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Farmers who own cultivable land in their own name. CANNOT apply if you: are a government official/employee, politician, doctor/engineer/lawyer, earn enough to pay income tax, or receive a monthly pension of Rs. 10,000+.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Any Indian citizen, including minors above 10 years (with parent's help). No income or profession restrictions.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Rs. 2,000 cash every 4 months (3 times per year), directly to your bank account.
comparisons.scheme2_value: A zero-balance savings account + a free RuPay debit card with Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance + option to borrow up to Rs. 10,000.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar card, land ownership papers, and active bank account details (Aadhaar-linked).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar card, government photo ID (Voter Card/PAN/Ration Card), address proof (bill/passport), passport photo, and filled account form.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online only at pmkisan.gov.in. Enter Aadhaar, get OTP, fill form, upload documents, submit. Can also apply via CSCs (Common Service Centers).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Go to any bank branch with the printed form (downloaded from pmjdy.gov.in), filled out and signed. Submit with documents. (Portal is for information/forms only, not submission.)

comparisons.scheme1_value: No deadline — registration stays open year-round. New installments released every 4 months.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No deadline — accounts can be opened anytime.

comparisons.scheme1_value: If ANY family member paid income tax last year, the ENTIRE family becomes ineligible. Land must be in YOUR name only.
comparisons.scheme2_value: If you open a 'Small Account' (without documents), it expires after 12 months unless you apply for a government ID.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) — money goes automatically to your Aadhaar-linked savings account.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Deposits/withdrawals at bank branch, ATM, or through Bank Mitra (village banking agents). Withdrawals limited to 4 per month for basic accounts.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Farmers with land who need extra cash for farm expenses (seeds, fertilizer, tools).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Anyone without a bank account who wants to save money safely and get access to loans/insurance.

recommendation: These two schemes serve DIFFERENT purposes and can work together: PM-KISAN gives cash to farmers for farming; PMJDY opens a bank account for anyone. A farmer can use PM-KISAN to receive Rs. 6,000 per year AND have a PMJDY account to keep that money safe. However, if you pay income tax, you CANNOT get PM-KISAN, but you CAN still get a PMJDY account. Choose based on your need: farming support (PM-KISAN) or banking access (PMJDY). **DISCLAIMER:** This is AI guidance based on official documents. For final decisions, verify with official portals (pmkisan.gov.in and pmjdy.gov.in) or contact helplines. This is not legal or official advice.
